guidance.paragraph1: The tribunal will usually make its decision based on the documents and evidence provided by you and the landlord.
guidance.paragraph2: Only ask for a hearing if you want to attend a tribunal to add to the documents and evidence you have provided. The tribunal will consider all documents and evidence with or without a hearing.
guidance.paragraph3: The tribunal will decide if a hearing is needed.

reasonHearingRequested.label: Tell us why you think a hearing is needed
